Answer: F
Reason: The CT images show a large right pleural effusion with compressive atelectasis of the right lung, while the heart size appears normal. In an elderly patient with these findings and no cardiomegaly, Scimitar syndrome (a congenital venolobar syndrome) is a recognized cause of right-sided volume overload and effusion, distinguishing it from typical congestive heart failure which would present with an enlarged heart.
